text:
Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment 
inspection I1, to be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in 
above title block.
The oil system of 
turbine is used for lubricating and distributing circuits
Technical 
specification

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Mohammed 
Abd El-Kader, accepted 
by maintenance manager eng. Mohammed Farag, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; EDEPC inspection & quality 
control's general director, and approved by eng.
Fathy Mahmoud Ragab head sector of Talkha Power Station 
2x210MW.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control's general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance stuff should be 
 carrying the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as
 safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the oil pump motor.
Be sure oil system of turbine must be completely drained.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller.
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometer, Straight edge,
Rags
Work to be Carried Out
Oil system of Turbine in Operation
Check the oil level in main tank and analyze it 
 and determine what to do.
Check the pressure of oil and compare it with 
 the setting value and determine what to 
 do.
Oil system of Turbine 
out of Operation
Check and calibrate oil pressure gauges.
Check the oil level in main tank.
Make test for oil
 main tank and add or change it (if it is 
 needed).
Check bolts fixation, then re-tight it (if it 
 is needed).
Check glands of valves for leaking and replace them if it is needed.
Check flanges for leaking.
Check the pipes casing against rust and 
 re-paint (if it is needed).
